institution.description: A named institution in the article (the Federal Reserve / FOMC / 'the central bank', merged into one entity).

person.description: A named person in the article.

decision.description: The Wednesday, September 16, 2026 rate decision, reified as an event-like entity.

rate_range.description: A named federal funds target rate range, treated as an opaque tag, not a pair of numbers.

moment.description: A date, meeting, or clock time referred to in the article, treated as an opaque tag, not a computable timestamp.

year.description: A calendar year referred to as a target or projection horizon.

goal.description: A named policy goal or promise the article attributes to someone.

text.description: A statement, quoted remark, or pledge, reified as an opaque entity standing for its (unmodelled) propositional content.

cause.description: A named cause-of-inflation label that a Fed statement may or may not attribute inflation to.

event.description: A scheduled event other than the rate decision itself.

figure.description: A specific reported economic statistic (e.g. one quarter's PCE inflation estimate), treated as an opaque tag, not a number.

unanimous.description: Recorded as approved without a dissenting vote, per the reported vote.

raised_on.description: Recorded as the institution having raised its policy rate on this date.

voted_for.description: Recorded as the person having voted for (joined) this decision.

raised_to.description: Recorded as the institution having raised its policy rate to this named target range.

promised.description: OPAQUE marker predicate. Recorded as the person having promised this goal. The commissive force of 'promised' and the propositional content of the goal are not modelled; see GAPS.md.

submitted_projection.description: Recorded as the person having submitted an individual rate projection ('dot') for this meeting.

is_first_under.description: OPAQUE marker predicate. Recorded as this decision being the first policy shift during this person's tenure. Hides the ordinal comparison against an unenumerated sequence of other decisions; see GAPS.md.

appointed_by.description: Recorded as the first person having been selected/appointed by the second.

took_office_in.description: Recorded as the person having taken office during this (imprecisely named) period.

projected_for.description: Recorded as this rate range being the one projected to hold at the end of this year.

stated.description: OPAQUE marker predicate. Recorded as the institution having issued this statement. The quoted content of the statement is opaque; see GAPS.md.

attributes_to.description: Recorded as the statement attributing (elevated) inflation to this named cause.

scheduled_for.description: Recorded as the event being scheduled for this named clock time.

exceeds.description: Recorded as the first reported figure being numerically greater than the second, as a ground fact asserted per named pair. This is NOT arithmetic: it carries no information about any figure not named in this vocabulary, and no magnitude; see GAPS.md.

projected_year.description: Recorded as this goal (e.g. reaching the 2% inflation target) being projected to occur in this year.

pledged.description: OPAQUE marker predicate. Recorded as the person having pledged this statement. The commissive force of 'pledged' and the quoted content are not modelled; see GAPS.md.

fed.description: The Federal Reserve / FOMC / 'the central bank', as referred to in the article.

rate_decision.description: The Wednesday, September 16, 2026 decision to raise the target rate.

r375_400.description: The 3.75%-4.00% target range the Fed moved to on September 16, 2026.

r400_425.description: The 4.00%-4.25% target range projected for year-end 2026 and 2027.

sept16.description: Wednesday, September 16, 2026, the day of the rate decision.

late_may_2026.description: The imprecisely named period ('late May') when Warsh took office.

sept_meeting.description: The September 2026 FOMC meeting, at which Warsh again did not submit a projection.

t1430edt.description: 2:30 p.m. EDT, the scheduled start of Warsh's press conference.

t1830gmt.description: 18:30 GMT, the article's own restatement of the same press-conference start time.

y2026.description: Calendar year 2026 ('the end of this year').

y2029.description: Calendar year 2029, the newly projected year for reaching the 2% inflation target.

lower_prices_goal.description: Trump's promised goal of lowering prices.

prev_statement.description: The FOMC's previous policy statement, which attributed elevated inflation partly to 'supply shocks'.

new_statement.description: The FOMC's September 16, 2026 policy statement, which dropped the 'supply shocks' reference.

statement_timelier.description: The quoted remark: 'Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2% goal.'

pledge_lower_inflation.description: Warsh's quoted pledge to lower inflation 'clearly and at sufficient speed'.

supply_shocks.description: The 'supply shocks' label for a driver of elevated inflation.

press_conference.description: Warsh's press conference following the rate decision.

pce_sep.description: The September 2026 projection of PCE inflation (reported as 3.7%).

pce_jun.description: The June 2026 projection of PCE inflation (reported as 3.6%).

growth_sep.description: The September 2026 projection of economic growth (reported as 2.3%).

growth_jun.description: The June 2026 projection of economic growth (reported as 2.2%).

unemployment_sep.description: The September 2026 projection of year-end unemployment (reported as 4.1%).

unemployment_jun.description: The June 2026 projection of year-end unemployment (reported as 4.3%).
